segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מִנְחָה שֶׁלֹּא נִקְמְצָה, וְהִקְרִיבָהּ בַּחוּץ – פָּטוּר. קְמָצָהּ, וְחָזַר קוּמְצָהּ לְתוֹכָהּ, וְהִקְרִיבוֹ בַּחוּץ – חַיָּיב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If there is «a meal offering» from «which a handful was not removed, and one sacrificed it outside» the Temple courtyard, he is «exempt» from liability, because until the handful is actually removed it is not fit to be burned on the altar inside the Temple. But if a priest «took a handful from it and» then «returned its handful into» the remainder of the meal offering, «and one sacrificed» the entire mixture «outside» the courtyard, he is «liable,» as once the handful has been removed it is fit to be burned on the altar inside the Temple, and one is liable for offering it up outside even though it is mixed into the remainder.

moves.summary: Unremoved-handful meal offering offered outside: exempt
Handful removed and returned, whole offered outside: liable

positions.claim: An unremoved-handful meal offering offered outside is exempt; a handful removed then returned and offered outside is liable
